definition: HCP hospital pathway and current-care comparator
collection_note: Record pathway version, approvals, period and follow-up window. No patient data belong in this public tool.
Separate from episodes and test counts. Retain any identifiers only in an approved local clinical system.

definition: Distinct qualifying acute-care episodes with planned index testing
collection_note: Define repeat presentations and prevent duplicate counting.

definition: Baseline admissions in tested episodes whose occupied stay the pathway could change
collection_note: A local eligibility definition; not inferred from a normal neutrophil result.

definition: Initial plus invalid, repeat and wasted kits
collection_note: Use direct counts, not an assumed unlimited-retry formula.

definition: Time of sampling, usable result and clinical review
collection_note: These intervals are process measures, not automatically released bed-days.

definition: Actual inpatient occupancy using a pre-specified consistent definition
collection_note: Use comparable episodes and the same follow-up window; include reattendance and readmission occupancy.

definition: Total staff minutes per episode and per kit
collection_note: Separate incremental paid time from redeployed time. Capture training and follow-up.

definition: Additional assessments, travel and community or hospital contacts
collection_note: Identify costs displaced elsewhere; avoid adding full admission costs to the same bed-day costs.
Include treatment delays, reattendance, readmission and other agreed harms. Establish governance independently of this calculator.

definition: Delivered kit price, paid staff, setup, QA, software, support and follow-up
collection_note: Record quote/source, date, payer and tax basis. Count each resource once.
Capacity valuation is not automatically avoidable cash expenditure.

definition: Locally evidenced cash that can actually be removed from the budget
collection_note: Default zero unless finance agrees the mechanism and amount. Never add this to full resource value.

definition: Relevant comparison group, eligibility and risk profile
collection_note: A simple before-after difference is not causal evidence. Specify analysis and uncertainty with the evaluation team.
